about: Uzbek STT benchmark, run once per deploy (src/lib/benchmark.ts). 10 real people reading Uzbek sentences, 67 s in total, 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV. The text is each dataset's checked transcript. Read speech: scores here are better than on free conversation with Russian/English words mixed in.

sources.UzbekVoice: DavronSherbaev/uzbekvoice-filtered on Hugging Face (crowd-recorded, validated by listeners), Apache-2.0
sources.ISSAI USC: ISSAI Uzbek Speech Corpus, via murodbek/uzbek-speech-corpus on Hugging Face, CC-BY-4.0 (Musaev et al., USC: An Open-Source Uzbek Speech Corpus, 2021)
